prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
competitors_mentioned: Otterly.AI looks like a sensible starting point
answer_verbatim:
For a small business, **Otterly.AI looks like a sensible starting point**: the results list an entry plan at about **$29/month** and coverage for ChatGPT plus several other AI search platforms. It’s designed for tracking whether your business appears in answers to prompts you choose.

Before subscribing, check that it can track the questions your customers actually ask—for example, “best [service] in [city]”—and whether it reports **recommendations, competitor mentions, and cited sources**, not just whether your name appears. Pricing and included platforms can change, so verify the current plan details.

One caveat: AI answers vary by wording, location, and time. Treat any tracker as a trend indicator, not a definitive yes/no verdict. You can also test a few customer-style questions directly in ChatGPT and other engines, ideally in a fresh session and with your location specified.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
